newsitem.title: USA: Venture Nov same store sales fell 12.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Venture Nov same store sales fell 12.4 pct.

text.p: Venture Stores Inc said on Wednesday that same-store sales for the four week period ending with the week of Thanksgiving declined 12.4 percent.
Total sales fell 13.5 percent to $155.0 million versus November 1995 sales of $179.2 million.
Total sales for Thanksgiving week ended November 30 rose 9.3 percent to $57.9 million from $53.0 million in year-ago period ended November 25, 1995.
Same-store sales for this week increased 10.9 percent.

Sales for the fiscal month ended November 23 fell 30.3 percent to $124.9 million from $179.2 million in the year-ago period ended November 25, which included Thanksgiving week. Comparable store sales for this period declined 29.1 percent.

Year-to-date sales through November 23 dropped 25.4 percent to $1,135.8 million from $1,521.6 million for the same period last year. Comparable store sales for the year-to-date period declined 22.4 percent.

"We were very pleased with Venture's showing in the first week of the holiday season, which featured particularly good results for apparel, soft home goods, toys, electronics and home furnishings," said Robert N. Wildrick, Venture's chairman and chief executive officer. "Our latest round of store improvements and customer satisfaction initiatives appear to be bearing fruit."
Venture recently completed the second phase of its strategy to reposition itself as a family value retailer. Based on
response to these efforts, Wildrick said Venture intends to proceed with Phase III of its repositioning shortly after the end of the holiday selling season.
Venture operates 113 family value stores in nine states. ((--Chicago Newsdesk (312) 408-8787))
